signals_info.description: Signed lateral displacement from the lane center.

nl_Literal_translation_en: At the current time or at some future time, the lane offset shall be greater than -0.3 meters and less than 0.3 meters.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 在当前或未来某个时刻，车道横向偏移应大于 -0.3 米且小于 0.3 米。
nl_Paraphrase_en: The lateral lane offset shall have a magnitude strictly less than 0.3 meters now or at some later time.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: 车道横向偏移绝对值应在当前或之后某个时刻严格小于 0.3 米。
